note: Metadata projection uses repository-root-relative qualification evidence. The unchanged original contract uses a package-local report reference.

protocol.contextual_evaluation: All 40 pairs are training references, not a held-out contextual benchmark; depth/time diagnostics do not score contextual accuracy
protocol.interpretation: Agreement with same-AI-reviewed silver references; not independently verified accuracy or human gold labels

metrics.negative_passage_false_positive_rate: negative passages with >=1 in-profile prediction / negative passages; null when none
metrics.negative_support: Report negative passage count and false-positive passage count overall and by language
metrics.precision: TP/(TP+FP); null when denominator is zero
metrics.recall: TP/(TP+FN); null when denominator is zero

model_selection.configuration_policy: Freeze configuration identities before training; select using development results only
model_selection.test_boundary_audit: Deterministic token-boundary inspection is permitted here; it is not NER test evaluation
model_selection.test_policy: No test predictions, metrics or errors for tuning; final selected experiment only after configurations/checkpoints are frozen

pretrained_comparison.metric: Exact record/start/end matching in the separate coarse LOC task
pretrained_comparison.prediction: Use pretrained LOC predictions only; ORG/PER remain separate diagnostics
pretrained_comparison.reference: Collapse all six location classes to LOC, without merging adjacent entities

protocol.production_acceptance: Existing roadmap targets remain proposals pending baseline measurement; this protocol grants no production readiness

requirements: Document each emitted type to six-class label mapping and original character-offset convention
Validate source-exact offsets; preserve unresolved/unsupported types separately
Never infer a missing rule label or offset from reference annotations
